vault_registered.meaning: a vault is registered in the WERC7575ShareToken vault registry

unregister_blocked_by_dust.meaning: unregisterVault() is blocked (reverts) because excess underlying tokens not backed by shares were sent directly to the vault, so the external balanceOf() check fails
unregister_blocked_by_dust.checkpoint: after dust sent, at unregisterVault() call

unregister_permanently_blocked.meaning: unregisterVault() is permanently blocked so the vault remains registered indefinitely
unregister_permanently_blocked.checkpoint: after dust sent, at unregisterVault() call

assumptions: unregisterVault() is the operation whose completion is required for a registered vault

unresolved.description: The intent's requirement that the check reflect internal accounting (totalAssets()) rather than external balanceOf() is a mechanism/root-cause statement; the required_effect pattern encodes only the completion obligation (unregister not blocked by dust), not the accounting-source comparison.

limitations: The 1 wei magnitude and 'permanently' duration are captured only qualitatively via the blocked/permanently-blocked booleans; no numeric dust amount or time bound is encoded.
The intent's totalAssets() vs balanceOf() distinction is not represented as a separate predicate.
